Requirement You are performing an Install check on your own body, using your own tools.

You've done this to machines a hundred times; doing it to yourself is just a smaller job with worse lighting. When you self-install or self-remove a cyber-augment, ignore the usual −2 circumstance penalty for lacking a proper table. The install still takes the normal recovery — clumsy 1 and drained 1 for the augment's Grade in days — you just don't botch the wiring doing it alone.
